evidence: 20 Antigravity Skills authored in .agent/skills/ (PM, Verifier, Commander + 17 specialists)

Each SKILL.md has frontmatter (name, description, metadata.type, version, tier), purpose, triggers, inputs, procedure with concrete coefficients, output envelope, rules, failure modes, worked examples
Mission Control fan-out documented in docs/antigravity-usage.md
Traces emitted as structured envelopes per tier; artifact tree under artifacts/<run-id>/
6 signal sources fused (social, weather, traffic, sensors, citizen reports, historical) — exceeds 3 source minimum
Credibility formula with 6 explicit terms (verified, followers, age, geo, urgency, contradiction)
5-vote LLM ensemble for type + median-vote severity
Severity rubric is data-driven (population × hazard × sensors) — not LLM-improvised
Monte Carlo 200-sample uncertainty bands (p10/p50/p90) on radius, population, duration
Contradiction detection + recovery loop (verification → recall) with audit chain
60-asset roster across 9 capability types in sim/fixtures/resources.json
Hungarian (scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment) bipartite matcher with cost = travel + capability_overlap_penalty - priority_bonus + fatigue
Prioritizer emits explainable trade_offs strings + recommended_resource_share softmax
Floor assignment guarantees coverage for high-pop incidents
Scenario B demonstrates concurrent multi-crisis with explicit allocator alternatives_considered
Simulator produces before/after for dispatch, reroute, alert, hospital_prep with quantified side effects
evacuation_jam_probability via logistic over pop_affected
requires_staging flag triggers batched alerts
6 stakeholder channels per incident: public (UR+EN), hospital, utility (mapped to WASA/IESCO/SNGPL), traffic police, media, command-center JSON
Mobile command center shows live trace pane + scenario runner
Scenario D demonstrates weather API outage → cache fallback + stale_minutes flag
Round latency p50=53ms, p95=70ms (100x under the 8s target)
Cost projection ~$0.02 per incident at Gemini 3 Flash pricing (docs/cost-latency.md)
Scaling story documented in docs/scalability.md (laptop → city → multi-city)
SQLite → Postgres swap is a one-line change; audit_log already INSERT-only
Bilingual (Urdu + English) public alerts via Gemini-or-glossary translation
Retraction transparency: retracted alerts remain visible in citizen app with strikethrough — never deleted
Expert-correction trust mechanism: high-trust citizens (e.g., field engineers) can flip classifications + dampen competing hypotheses
Antigravity-style trace pane on the Command Center surface (mobile mirror of Mission Control)
Sprint methodology with PM Agent + Verifier Agent as first-class skills

deliverables_check.web_dashboard_optional: deferred — Command Center surface on the Flutter app serves the same role
deliverables_check.readme: README.md covers architecture, schemas, antigravity usage, APIs, assumptions, privacy, cost, baseline, scalability, limitations

notes: All six rubric dimensions strongly covered. The deliberate dual-entry design (Antigravity Skills + Python mirror) means the same logic is traceable to judges via Mission Control and runnable in production behind the mobile app.
